name: Restart Print Spooler (Windows)
description: Restarts the Print Spooler service and reports its state before and after. Dry run by default.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When true (default) nothing is changed and the script only reports what it would do.

output: State before/after with [DONE]/[SKIP] lines, or a [DRY-RUN] line. Exit 0; 3 if the spooler is not running afterwards.
